hints.title: Linear Mountain Scan
hints.text: For n up to 10^5, solve in O(n) time by anchoring the middle mountain element j.

hints.title: Prefix and Suffix Precomputations
hints.text: Compute running prefix minimums left[j - 1] and suffix minimums right[j + 1].

hints.title: Peak Condition
hints.text: Whenever left[j - 1] < nums[j] and right[j + 1] < nums[j], update answer with their sum.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Two linear scans with prefix and suffix minimum arrays.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: O(n^2) or O(n^3) checks time out for n = 100,000.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary memory for prefix and suffix arrays.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Linear time solution using prefix and suffix minimum arrays.
